notes: Account background: mid-market native e-comm marketplace focused on lifestyle + seasonal categories. Catalog ~5M SKUs across partners; primary storefront latency and conversion metrics tied to relevance.
Primary ask: reduce search unit economics while preserving top-N precision. Current stack: vector store + in-house cross-encoder. Cross-encoder costs spike during promos; need fallback plan.
Scale requirements: expected 10x QPS during BFCM (historical peak). Baseline traffic ~200 QPS -> peak ~2000 QPS. Want predictable cost at peak.
Indexing: nightly full reindex not acceptable. Need incremental/delta ingestion with per-item upserts and eventual consistency window <= 15 minutes for inventory-sensitive SKUs.
Retrieval plan: hybrid ANN + lexical, retrieve top-200 then rerank top-20 with cross-encoder. SE recommends candidate size tuning to control reranker cost.
Latency targets: retrieval p50 < 40ms, reranker end-to-end (retrieve+rerank) p95 < 200ms for web queries; mobile target p95 < 300ms.
Cost targets: aim for average cost-per-query < $0.03 across traffic mix; must cap per-query spend during promos or apply fallback to distilled reranker.
Engineering concerns: cold start for large indices after failover, shard redistribution time, checkpointing KV caches.
Security: must support SAML SSO for internal portals, KMS integration for key management, and audit logs retained 2 years. Also data residency for EU customers (subset of catalog data).
Quote from VP Product: "We can’t accept a 10x increase in unit costs for Black Friday — need an elastic, cheaper rerank path."
POC success criteria (agreed): 1) match current top-5 CTR within 5% at baseline cost, 2) demonstrate <2x cost increase at 5x traffic, 3) incremental indexing latency <15 min for critical SKUs.
Current tech debt: embeddings generation is single-threaded worker producing 1k embeddings/min — needs batching/throughput improvement for full reindex.
Possible Redwood wins: dedicated GPU pool for reranking, intelligent batching + prefix cache to drop token cost, suggested quantized reranker model for inference speed/cost tradeoff.
Commercial notes: Finance wants granular monthly committed capacity + overage tiers. Interested in 12-month reserved capacity if cost per-query guarantees met.
Next POC task: SE to run A/B with two rerank strategies (full cross-encoder vs distilled teacher-student) on 100k query replay and provide token-cost projection.
